main_text.p: saltem vulnerandi. Cumque lucentibus concurrant mucro-nibus, damnum datum, non casui, sed conditioni talis con-gressus imputabitur..

Neque hic dissentiunt Canones, qui omnia duella oftentationis gratia adhibita omnino damnant. Ita torneamenta prohibentur,Can. 1. de Tor-neam, in quibus milites ex condicto[?] convenire solent, & ad ostentationem virium suarum, & audacia temere congredi: unde mortis hominum & animarum pericula se-Conft.de an.1567. Cal.No-vembr.pe proveniunt. Quo etiam facit constitutio Pii 5. Quae incipit de salute gregis. Quam ob eam rationem edidit, ne spectacula ferarum cum hominibus permitterentur.

page.notes: The text at the very top of the page is a fragment continuing from the previous page ("saltem"). The catchword "ba-" stands alone at the lower right. The italic word "condicto" is uncertain (marked [?]). The hyphenated word at the line end "se-pe" is set in italics and its exact letters are not fully certain. The printed double full stop after "imputabitur" is kept as printed. There is a small mark at the foot of the page that is not text and is left out.
